cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Admit You’re Hurt
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. When Mum cancelled our birthday dinner, were you disappointed?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'd like your answer before I give mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I cried in the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Me too. I told the cashier the birthday candles were seasonal allergies.
